methodology: PHASE_1_INTEGRITY: Commit verification, bundle SHA-256, source hash comparison, reproducible compilation, ABI/bytecode match
PHASE_2_CONTRACT_AUDIT: Manual line-by-line review of all 4 contracts for supply, access control, reentrancy, replay, overflow, upgradeability, events, DoS, domain separation
PHASE_3_TESTING: npm ci, compile, test:contracts, test:preflight, test:bundle, audit:static, bundle:verify, npm audit
PHASE_4_CONTROL_PLANE: Authentication, CSRF, authorization, rate limiting, idempotency, schema validation, secret exposure, settlement integrity
PHASE_5_THREAT_MODEL: 15 threat scenarios evaluated including authority compromise, bundle substitution, replay, Sybil, censorship, key loss, forks, centralization

findings.title: Unclaimed settlement funds locked permanently
findings.description: No mechanism to expire, cancel, or recover funds from partially or fully unclaimed settlements. reservedAmount stays inflated.
findings.impact: Permanent loss of testnet TOKOIN, reduced effective balance for future settlements.
findings.recommendation: Add time-bounded recovery mechanism callable by settlement authority.

findings.title: Zero-amount claim not rejected at contract level
findings.description: claim() does not require amount > 0. Protected at application layer by buildSettlementBundle().
findings.impact: No economic impact. Wastes gas. Emits misleading events.
findings.recommendation: Add require(amount > 0) for defense in depth.

findings.title: No emergency pause or root correction mechanism
findings.description: Once a settlement root is published, it cannot be corrected, paused, or invalidated.
findings.impact: Incorrect root allows incorrect claims with no on-chain mechanism to halt.
findings.recommendation: For testnet, acceptable given multisig. For mainnet, add time-locked pause.

findings.title: Duplicate revocation emits redundant events
findings.description: revoke() can be called multiple times on same token, emitting IdentityRevoked each time.
findings.impact: No security impact. May confuse event indexers.
findings.recommendation: Add already-revoked guard or accept as intentional.

findings.title: Permissionless claim allows third-party forcing
findings.description: Any address can call claim() with valid proof. Tokens go to correct account but recipient cannot opt out.
findings.impact: Recipient receives tokens without consent. Standard Merkle airdrop pattern.
findings.recommendation: For testnet, accept as-is. Standard pattern.

findings.title: Settlement authority single point of trust
findings.description: settlementAuthority is immutable. Cannot be rotated or transferred. Mitigated by SAFE_2_OF_3.
findings.impact: Key compromise requires redeployment. Key loss prevents new settlements.
findings.recommendation: Acceptable for testnet. Document recovery procedure.

findings.title: No tokenURI implementation
findings.description: Inherits default ERC721 tokenURI returning empty string. No metadata for NFT explorers.

findings.title: Off-chain control plane authorization gaps
findings.description: Settlement allocations not verified as owned by API caller. Rate limiting absent on settlement/reservation endpoints.
findings.impact: Authenticated user could create allocations referencing arbitrary agents. Mitigated by require_local_control_plane().
findings.recommendation: Add agent-ownership validation and rate limiting.

findings.title: Production guard single point of failure
findings.description: require_local_control_plane() is the sole guard against production mutations.
findings.impact: Configuration error could enable mutations in production.
findings.recommendation: Add defense-in-depth with secondary environment checks.

findings.title: Issuer cannot be rotated
findings.description: issuer is immutable. Same pattern as settlement authority.
findings.impact: Key loss prevents new identity minting. Key compromise allows arbitrary minting (soulbound limits damage).
findings.recommendation: Mitigated by SAFE_2_OF_3. Acceptable for testnet.
